maya: deploy-bot flagged eu-canary p95 surge right after v4.1.2. Autorevert queued in 3m. Anyone here?

deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT SUGGESTED -> metric: p95_latency_eu > 1.0s (now=1.4s). Will autorevert in 3m unless `override:manual`.

infra: saw an index-warmup job running during rollout, might be correlated. don't want to autorevert while migration halfway.

maya: agree. request manual rollback limited to canary hosts and hold prod traffic. ops-lead, can you sign off?

oncall-bot: Manual override required. @ops-lead please respond within 2m or deploy-bot will autorevert.

ops-lead: Approved manual scoped rollback to canary only. Do not rollback DB migration.

devx: freezing release notes and drafting short customer line. will wait for final status.

maya: running commands: `rwctl routes pin --service inference-eu --version v4.1.1 --duration 1h` then `deploy rollback --region eu --scope canary --to v4.1.1`.

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-276700 started. streaming: reverting canary pods...

deploy-bot: rollback complete. post-check p95_eu=420ms, error_rate=0.18%.

maya: ticket RB-2767 opened. pin 1h. devx please send customer blurb once I confirm stability for 15m.

ops-lead: keep pin, add presubmit to block rollouts during active migration jobs.

maya: noted. closing thread, will follow up with a short postmortem.
